notes.title: Breakers Collection - Second Update
Breakers Collection first patch and in-game event!
Breakers Collection first patch and in-game event!
Welcome to the Breakers Collection Online Open Beta
Inside QUByte: Breakers Collection Team Battle Mode
notes.content:
Hello Breakers Fans!

Tune TODAY in our special #BreakersCollection livestream at 2 PM PDT/18h de Brasília for a GAMEPLAY SHOWCASE of the brand new Team Battle mode!

Check our channels below 👇


 Youtube
 Twitch
 Steam


Breakers Collection features both Breakers and Breakers Revenge, cult-classics among the fans of the genre, with all the original content as released in the 1990s for the Neo Geo and Arcades, as well as brand new content, such as Online and Training Modes, to offer fans of the originals and newcomers alike the ultimate Breakers experience.

Breakers Collection will be available on PC, PlayStation®4, PlayStation®5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X/S and Nintendo Switch in 2022.
